title: Coordination ledger task entry
description: One task record in the append-only coordination ledger — a single JSON object per line in tasks.jsonl. The generic, runtime-agnostic model encoded by framework/coordination/ledger.md.

id.description: Stable unique task id. The latest ledger line for an id wins.

title.description: One-line imperative summary of the task.

description.description: Fuller task brief or handoff context.

owner.description: Role/agent that currently owns the task; null when unclaimed.

risk_level.description: high/critical auto-escalate to the human tiebreaker.

files_owned.description: Normalized paths this task write-locks while claimed — the collision guard.

depends_on.description: Task ids that must complete before this one can start.

verification_command.description: Machine check that proves the task done.

due_at.description: Earliest time the scheduler may dispatch this task. Absent = dispatchable as soon as it is ready (dependencies met).

schedule.description: Recurring cadence for a proactive task, as an interval expression (e.g. '@every 30m', '@every 1h', '@every 90s'). The scheduler re-dispatches when the interval has elapsed since metadata.last_run_at. Full cron is the instance's job; this is the portable heartbeat form.

review_required.description: Whether completion routes to cross-review (Council default: true).

review_round.description: Cross-review ping-pong count; exceeding the cap escalates.

claimed_by_pid.description: Process id that holds the claim (liveness).

transitions.description: Optional append-only audit trace of lifecycle changes — the cause behind each status transition. The latest ledger line still wins for current state; this records why the state got there.

rationale.description: Why the transition happened — the decision behind it.

evidence.description: Optional pointer to proof — a commit, an artifact, a log location.

metadata.description: Instance-specific extension fields the generic model does not define.
